decisions.reason: The cobot loading system extends the firm's established machining offer and fits its announced push toward smarter automation, so dropping it would write off development work tied to that direction, and its early results can still be read as a normal launch ramp-up.

The dual-table loading system is a low-risk add-on to the core machines that supports the automation strategy, and there is no evidence of failure that would force management to justify abandoning it.

The dispensing machine is a heavily invested, publicly showcased flagship with its own page and a Red Dot award, so management is strongly committed and would attribute any weak sales to temporary market-entry causes rather than drop it.
